description: This file provides cgo bindings and utility functions for interacting with systemd via dynamic loading of shared libraries, including retrieving the current systemd unit, checking if running from a system service, and getting the active slice.

methods.name: getRunningSlice
methods.description: Retrieves the current systemd slice name by dynamically loading systemd libraries and calling the appropriate function.

methods.name: runningFromSystemService
methods.description: Determines if the current process is running as a systemd service by checking ownership UID and session leadership.

methods.name: currentUnitName
methods.description: Gets the name of the current systemd unit associated with the process.
